scenarios.title: Razorpay order creation and paise conversion
scenarios.idempotency_behavior: If a pending payment row already exists on the booking, createOrder returns HTTP 200 with message 'Existing pending payment found' rather than creating a duplicate Razorpay order.

scenarios.title: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification
scenarios.mechanism: Local cryptographic verification via hash_hmac('sha256', order_id . '|' . payment_id, secret)

scenarios.title: Invalid signature verification and transaction rollback

observed_behavior.database_state: Because the exception is thrown inside DB::transaction(), the update of payment to 'failed' is rolled back by MySQL, leaving the payment and booking in 'pending' status.

scenarios.architectural_finding: The current implementation intended to record payment_status='failed', but threw an exception within the same uncommitted transaction, causing MySQL to revert the mutation.

input.scenario: Submitting verification for an order already marked as paid

observed_behavior.exception_thrown: Payment already verified for this order.
